root_cause.summary: Test-setup defect, not runtime. The gate built its distance scenario before the player node had finished its initial settle, so the node moved out from under the placement.
root_cause.who_moved: The player node. The tree never moved after the write. The controller was still settling the node onto the terrain (Y rose 0 -> 0.3086) and drifting horizontally (X fell 0.633 then a further 0.138).
root_cause.why_order_mattered: Running GroundLoot first absorbed the settle, so by the time Gathering ran the node was already static. That is why the gate passed only in that order.
hypotheses_disproved: Resource re-projection from the snapshot: the snapshot carries no position for a resource entry (position field empty); Godot owns a deterministic placeholder grid instead.
Physics fall of the resource: ResourceNode is a StaticBody3D and does not fall.
Interaction anchor offset: ResourceNode.interaction_anchor_world_position() returns global_position, and root/anchor coincided in the trace.

work_item_2_gathering_isolation.fix: The gate waits for the player node to be stable for 20 consecutive physics frames before building the scenario, then asserts the resulting range against the contract.

order_independence.configuration: Gathering isolated on a clean world

known_fragility_reported_not_fixed.recommendation: Treat like the other placement fragilities already fixed: make the check sample the authoritative HP around the replay instead of relying on ambient world state.
